props.name: Equipment
props.description: Store equipped items in your backpack and equip items from it (armor excepted). No roll.

props.name: Guard
props.description: Until the start of your next turn you have Resistance to all damage types and a +2 bonus to Opposed Checks. You may also Cover one ally, who cannot be targeted by melee attacks until then.

effects.name: Guard
effects.description: Guard: Resistance to all damage + 2 to Opposed Checks until your next turn.

effects.name: Covered
effects.description: Covered: Cannot be targeted by melee attacks until the guard's next turn.

props.name: Hinder
props.description: Make an attribute Check against a creature. On a success, it suffers a status of your choice (Dazed, Shaken, Slow, or Weak).

props.name: Study
props.description: Make an Open Check (【INS + INS】) to learn about a creature. The higher the result, the more its Monster Encyclopedia entry reveals.
During the first round of a conflict, you gain Resistance to all damage types and you cannot be afflicted by status effects.
props.name: Rampart

effects.name: Rampart Ready
effects.description: Rampart: Once per conflict. Spend 20 MP at round start to fire.

effects.name: Rampart
effects.description: Rampart: Resistance to all damage + status immunity until end of round.

props.description: Once per scene, when you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, you may have your Hit Points be reduced to 1 instead.
props.name: Unbreakable

effects.name: Unbreakable Ready
effects.description: Unbreakable: Once per scene. Survive a fatal hit at 1 HP.

props.description: If you perform the 【Guard】 action and choose to provide cover to another creature, that creature gains Resistance to all damage types until the start of your next turn.
props.name: Bodyguard

effects.name: Bodyguard
effects.description: Bodyguard: Resistance to all damage.

props.description: As long as you have a shield or a martial armor equipped, all damage you suffer is reduced by 【SL】 (applied before damage Affinities).
props.name: Defensive Mastery

effects.name: Defensive Mastery
effects.description: Defensive Mastery: −SL damage while a shield or martial armor is equipped.

props.description:
You may now equip a shield in your main hand slot. As long as you have two shields equipped, you gain the benefits of both items and may treat them as the following combined two-handed melee brawling weapon:

Twin Shields — Accuracy: 【MIG + MIG】 — Damage: 【HR + 5】 physical

Deals extra damage equal to your SL in Defensive Mastery.
props.name: Dual Shieldbearer

effects.name: Dual Shieldbearer
effects.description: Dual Shieldbearer: Two shields equipped: gain Twin Shields attack (MIG+MIG, HR+5 physical, +SL Defensive Mastery damage).

props.description: Permanently increase your maximum Hit Points by 【SL × 5】.
props.name: Fortress

effects.name: Fortress
effects.description: Fortress: Max HP +5×SL.

props.description: When another creature is threatened by an attack, spell or other danger, you may take their place (any Checks that are part of the danger will be performed against you; you may declare the use of this Skill before or after the Checks have been made). If the danger already affected you, it affects you twice (resolve both instances separately); you also cannot protect multiple creatures from the same danger. If you use this Skill during a conflict, you cannot use it again until the start of your next turn.
props.name: Protect

effects.name: Protect
effects.description: Protect: Once per turn. Take an ally's incoming attack or status instead.

props.description:
As long as you have a weapon equipped in your main hand slot and a shield equipped in your off-hand slot, your attacks with that weapon deal 5 extra damage and you gain a +1 bonus to Defense.

This Skill cannot be combined with custom weapons with the defence boost customization, nor with the Dual Shieldbearer Skill.
props.heroic_requirement: You must have mastered one or more Classes among Commander and Guardian.
props.name: Hoplite

effects.name: Hoplite
effects.description: Hoplite: Wielding weapon + shield: +1 Defense, +5 main-hand damage.

props.description:
Your maximum Hit Points are permanently increased by an amount equal to your base Insight die size (update your maximum HP if this size changes).

When a conflict scene begins, if you have learned the Divination spell, you gain 1 Prophecy Point. You also gain 1 Prophecy Point at the start of each even-numbered round (regardless of whether you have learned Divination). You lose all Prophecy Points at the end of each scene.

When one or more allies are threatened by a single attack, spell, or other danger, you may spend 1 Prophecy Point to take the place of all those allies (any Checks that are part of the danger will be performed against you; you may declare the use of this Skill before or after the Checks have been made). The danger will affect you once for each creature it was threatening (including yourself, if you were among those creatures). Resolve each of these instances separately.
props.heroic_requirement: You must have mastered one or more Classes among Entropist and Guardian.
props.name: Prophetic Defender

effects.name: Prophecy Point
effects.description: Prophetic Defender: Spend to take the place of allies threatened by a danger.

effects.name: Prophetic Defender
effects.description: Prophetic Defender: Permanent +base Insight die size to maximum HP.

props.description:
As long as your personal vehicle has a steed frame, it may have up to 2 active weapon modules (instead of 1).

During a conflict, if you have a martial armor or martial armor module equipped, you may use an action and spend 30 Mind Points to choose earth or physical. If you do, you deal 20 damage of the chosen type to every enemy you can see, and enemies that lose Hit Points this way cannot perform free attacks until the start of their next turn.

This effect deals +10 damage if you are driving a personal vehicle with a mech frame and/or have two shields equipped, and also deals +10 damage if you are level 30 or higher.
props.heroic_requirement: You must have mastered one or more Classes among Guardian and Pilot.
props.name: Quaking Titan

effects.name: No Free Attack
effects.description: Quaking Titan: Cannot perform free attacks until start of next turn.

props.name: Elegance Showmanship
props.heroic_requirement: You must have mastered the Matador Class
props.description:
Double the bonus DEF you gained from 【📜Grace Under Pressure】

Additionally, if you would Fill any number of section on your Adoration Clock, Fill that many plus 1 instead

props.name: Pillage
props.description: When you use the 【Soul Steal】 Skill, you may target any number of creatures at the same time (you perform a single Check and compare it to the Magic Defense of each creature you are attempting to steal from).

props.name: Vanish
props.description: When you hit one or more creatures with an attack, you may spend 1 Fabula Point. If you do, each of those creatures will be unable to perform any action that requires them to be able to see you until the start of your next turn.

effects.name: Vanish
effects.description: Vanish: Cannot be targeted by enemies until start of your next turn.

props.name: Cheap Shot
props.description: When you hit a creature with an attack, if the attack only targeted that creature and they are suffering from one or more status effects, you may have it deal extra damage equal to 【SL + the number of status effects on the creature】.

props.name: Dodge
props.description: As long as you have no shields and no martial armor equipped, your Defense score is increased by 【SL】.

effects.name: Dodge
effects.description: Dodge: DEF +Level while no shield or martial armor is equipped.

props.name: High Speed
props.description:
At the start of a conflict, you may spend 10 Mind Points. If you do, choose one option and apply it before the start of the first round:

  • Perform a free attack with a weapon you have equipped

  • Perform a 【🚫Hinder】 or 【❗️Objective】 action. You also gain a bonus equal to 【SL】 to all Checks you perform as part of the chosen option.

props.name: See You Later
props.description: You may use an action and spend 1 Fabula Point to vanish from the current scene, reappearing whenever you want during a different scene in which another Player Character is present. Describe how you escaped and miraculously got here!

props.name: Soul Steal
props.description:
You may use an action to perform a 【DEX + WLP】 Check against the Magic Defense of a creature you can see. If you succeed and the target is a soldier, you recover 【SL】 Inventory Points.

Additionally, if they are an elite or champion, the GM gives you the target's soul treasure, an item worth an amount of zenit equal to or lower than 【the target's level multiplied by 30, or by 50 if they are a Villain】. This soul treasure will appear inside your backpack; a creature can be successfully stolen from with this Skill only once.

You gain a bonus equal to 【SL】 to your 【DEX + WLP】 Checks for this Skill.

1.menu_description: Spend 10 MP to target one additional creature.

props.description: When you perform a ranged attack, you may spend 10 Mind Points to have the attack target one additional creature. Loose a hail of shots!
props.name: Barrage

1.menu_description: Spend MP equal to the attacker's Accuracy Result to make the attack fail against all targets.

props.description:
After a creature you can see performs a ranged attack, you may spend an amount of Mind Points equal to the total Result of their Accuracy Check in order to have the attack fail automatically against all targets.

You can only use this Skill if you have a ranged weapon equipped, and it has no effect if the Accuracy Check was a critical success.
props.name: Crossfire

props.description:
When you perform the Guard action, if you choose not to provide cover to another creature, you may choose one option:

  • the next ranged attack you perform before the end of the current scene will deal 【SL】× 2 extra damage; or
  • you may immediately perform a free attack with a bow or firearm you have equipped, treating your High Roll (HR) as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack.

props.name: Hawkeye

effects.name: Hawkeye
effects.description: Hawkeye: your next ranged attack this scene deals extra damage.

props.name: Perfect Aim
props.description:
When you hit one or more creatures with a ranged attack and choose to deal no damage in order to gain the benefits of the Warning Shot Skill, you may choose two options instead of one (for instance, you could inflict both shaken and slow on each creature, or inflict a status effect on each creature while also lowering their Mind Points).

Requirements: you must have mastered the Sharpshooter Class, and must have acquired the Warning Shot Skill.
You gain a bonus equal to 【SL】 to all Accuracy Checks with ranged weapons.
props.name: Ranged Weapon Mastery

2.menu_subtitle: The attack deals no damage — choose an effect.
2.menu_option_labels: Inflict Shaken | Inflict Slow | Drain Mind Points
2.menu_option_descriptions: Each target hit by the attack becomes Shaken. | Each target hit by the attack becomes Slow. | Each target hit loses SL × 10 Mind Points.

props.description: When you hit one or more targets with a ranged attack that would deal damage, you may have the attack deal no damage. If you do, choose one option: inflict shaken on each target hit by the attack; or inflict slow on each target hit by the attack; or each target hit by the attack loses 【SL】× 10 Mind Points. Describe your maneuver!
props.name: Warning Shot
Bimagus
props.description: Once per turn during a conflict, if you have an arcane weapon equipped, you may use an action and spend 20 to 50 Mind Points to perform the 【📕Spell】 action for free twice, casting two spells without needing to pay their MP costs. If you do, the two spells must have a combined total MP cost equal to or lower than 【20 + the amount of MP you spent to use this Skill】, and the second spell must have a total MP cost that is equal to or lower than half the total MP cost of the first spell.

props.name: Healing Power
props.description: When you cast a spell that targets one or more allies, if you have an arcane weapon equipped, you may have each of those allies recover Hit Points equal to SL × the number of Bonds you have. Separate from any healing caused by the spell.

props.name: Ritual Spiritism
props.description: You may perform Rituals whose effects fall within the Spiritism discipline. Spiritism Rituals use INS + WLP for the Magic Check.

props.name: Spiritual Magic
props.description: Each time you acquire this Skill, learn one Spiritist spell (see Facet). Offensive Spiritist Spells use INS + WLP for the Magic Check.

props.name: Support Magic
props.description: When you cast a spell that targets one or more allies, if you have an arcane weapon equipped, you may choose one of those allies you have a Bond towards. That ally gains a bonus to their next Check during the current scene equal to the strength of your Bond toward them.

effects.name: Support Magic
effects.description: Bonus to next Check equal to the Spiritist's Bond strength toward this creature.

props.name: Vismagus
props.description: When you cast a spell, if you don't have enough Mind Points to pay for its total cost, you may choose to spend twice as many Hit Points instead. You cannot use this Skill if doing so would reduce you to 0 HP. If the spell would cause you to recover HP, you recover no HP (the spell still works on other targets).

props.name: Aura
props.description: You project your soul outside your body and direct it to surround the targets, shielding them from dangerous magic. Until this spell ends, each target may treat their Magic Defense as 12 against effects that target them (they keep their normal MDEF if higher).

effects.name: Aura
effects.description: Magic Defense floored at 12 — if the target's MDEF would be lower, it's treated as 12 instead. Normal MDEF still applies if higher.

props.name: Awaken
props.description: You allow a creature to focus their vital energy into accomplishing what they previously could not. Choose: Dexterity, Insight, Might, or Willpower. Until this spell ends, the target treats the chosen Attribute as if it were one die size higher (up to a maximum of d12).

props.name: Barrier
props.description: You project your soul outside your body and weave it into a barrier to protect the targets from attacks. Until this spell ends, each target may treat their Defense as 12 against effects that target them (they keep their normal DEF if higher).

effects.name: Barrier
effects.description: Defense floored at 12 — if the target's DEF would be lower, it's treated as 12 instead. Normal DEF still applies if higher.

props.name: Cleanse
props.description: You strengthen and purify the soul energy coursing through your companions. Each target recovers from 1 debuff of your choice (any active effect tagged as a debuff).

props.description: You cause a creature to lose any semblance of temper and act brazenly. The target hit by this spell (INS+WLP vs MDEF) suffers Enraged and cannot perform the Guard or Spell actions during their next turn.

You alter the senses of your enemies, causing them to experience bizarre or frightening hallucinations. Choose: Dazed or Shaken. Inflict the chosen status effect on each target hit by this spell (INS+WLP vs MDEF).

props.description: You strengthen the heart of a creature against suffering and despair. Until this spell ends, if the target would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, they are instead left at exactly 1 Hit Point. Once that happens, this spell ends.

effects.name: Mercy
effects.description: If this creature would be reduced to 0 HP, they are instead left at exactly 1 HP. Consumed on first trigger; this AE auto-removes when fired.

effects.name: Soul Weapon
effects.description: This creature's equipped-weapon attacks deal Light damage instead of their normal type.
